mkp-math:vector-field@1.name: vector-field
mkp-math:vector-field@1.about: Arrows of a vector field F(x, y) on a grid, scaled to fit, with a point to drag that reads the field.

inputs.name: f
inputs.about: the field, as a point (P, Q)

inputs.name: n
inputs.about: arrows along the shorter side; the longer side gets as many as fit

inputs.name: scale
inputs.about: fit: lengths in proportion, the longest fills a cell; unit: every arrow the same length

values.name: asp
comment: the view (plane.mkp): the ranges widened about their middle, one unit as long both ways

values.name: h
comment: square cells over the whole view, n along the shorter side, centred

value.expr: max(map(range(0, cols - 1), i => max(map(range(0, rows - 1), j => len2(f(cen(i, j).x, cen(i, j).y))))))

values.name: k
comment: how much to shrink a vector to fit a cell

values.name: tip
values.body: (q.x + s k(f(q.x, q.y)) f(q.x, q.y).x, q.y + s k(f(q.x, q.y)) f(q.x, q.y).y)
comment: q moved by s times the field's arrow there (the arrows are centred on their grid points)

values.name: vec
comment: an arrow centred on c along s v, with a head of length l: its shaft (a to b), its tip t and the head's corners

values.name: at2
values.body: vec(c, v, k(v), min(6 px, 0.45 k(v) len2(v)))
comment: the field's arrow at c: the head shrinks with a short arrow, as a drawn one does

values.name: arrows

value.expr: map(range(0, cols - 1), i => filter(map(range(0, rows - 1), j => at2(cen(i, j), f(cen(i, j).x, cen(i, j).y))), q => q.len > 1.5 px))

comment: by column (an each takes 200 items at most)

values.name: ps
comment: the probe's arrow from p: half as long again as the field's there, and never shorter than a cell and a half

value.expr: vec((p.x + ps fp.x/2, p.y + ps fp.y/2), fp, ps, min(10 px, 0.45 ps len2(fp)))

label.text: Arrows of the field on a grid, and a point to drag

comment: the probe: its ring, its arrow, the point

at.expr: (clamp(pt.x, vx0 + 30 px, vx1 - 40 px) + 6 px, clamp(pt.y, vy0 + 4 py, vy1 - 24 py) + 6 py)

core:canvas@1.name: canvas
core:canvas@1.about: A 2D coordinate space with layers drawn in the order written.

inputs.name: aspect
inputs.about: width over height; 0 means from the ranges

inputs.name: view
inputs.about: 3D camera: azimuth and elevation in degrees

core:zoom@1.name: zoom
core:zoom@1.about: A view the reader can zoom and pan once they unlock it, so scrolling the page past it is never caught by it. It starts locked; a try to zoom or pan then points at the lock.

core:frame@1.name: frame
core:frame@1.about: A widget's shell: what kind of thing it is and its title above a stage, and a bar of controls along the bottom. Nothing the reader does changes its size: what doesn't fit goes in its drawers or full screen.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: what kind of thing it is, said small before the title

inputs.name: height
inputs.about: the stage's height at rest (the reader can drag it); none: as tall as its content

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: one line in the bar: what is happening now

inputs.name: statuslines
inputs.about: how many lines the status keeps room for (1 to 3): a verdict with its reason

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: tints the bar: how an answer went (ok, bad) or a note (info)

inputs.name: actions
inputs.about: right of the title: the widget's own switches

inputs.name: bar
inputs.about: the bar: what is placed here, after the widget's own controls

inputs.name: about
inputs.about: a drawer: assumptions, and how to read it

inputs.name: details
inputs.about: a drawer: everything at once, such as the full table

mkp-math:numbered#0.src: filter(ticks(lo, hi, step), v => v > lo + (hi - lo)/70 and v < hi - (hi - lo)/70 and not (crossed and abs(v - cross) < step/1000))

mkp-math:tick#0.name: tick
mkp-math:tick#0.src: if(not im, "$\val{format(v, places(step))}$", if(abs(v - 1) < step/1000, "$i$", if(abs(v + 1) < step/1000, "$-i$", "$\val{format(v, places(step))}i$")))
